Here are the specifications for the **Redragon Kumara K552 RGB LED Backlit Mechanical Gaming Keyboard (Blue Switches)** :


---


**Redragon Kumara K552 - Mechanical Gaming Keyboard**


**Brand:** Redragon  

**Model:** Kumara K552  

**Type:** Mechanical Gaming Keyboard  

**Layout:** 87 Keys (Tenkeyless - TKL, no numpad)  

**Color:** Black  


---


**Switches:**  

Switch Type: Outemu Blue (Mechanical, Clicky)  

Actuation Force: 50g  

Actuation Distance: 2.0mm  

Total Travel Distance: 4.0mm  

Click Sound: Yes (Loud, tactile, clicky)  

Durability: 50 million keystrokes  


---


**Connectivity:**  

Connection Type: Wired (USB)  

Cable Length: 1.8 meters (6 feet)  

Cable Type: Braided (tangle-resistant)  


---


**Key Features:**  

N-Key Rollover (NKRO): Yes (Full anti-ghosting)  

Windows Key Disable: Yes (Lock/Unlock)  

Multimedia Keys: Yes (via Function keys)  

Wrist Rest: No  

USB Pass-through: No  

Hot-swappable switches: No  


---


**Construction:**  

Top Plate: Aluminum / Steel (metal construction)  

Keycaps: Double-shot injection molded ABS  

Legs: Foldable rubberized feet (adjustable height)  

Non-slip Pads: Yes (rubberized bottom)  

Weight: 1 kg (2.2 lbs)  

Dimensions: 355 x 135 x 40 mm (13.9" x 5.3" x 1.5")  


---


**Software/Diver:**  

Software Name: Redragon Software (downloadable)  

Macro Support: Yes (programmable keys)  

Profile Saving: Yes  

On-board Memory: Yes (save profiles to keyboard)  


---


**Compatibility:**  

Operating Systems: Windows 7/8/10/11, macOS (limited functions), Linux (basic)  

Devices: PC, Laptop  


---


**Package Includes:**  

Redragon Kumara K552 Keyboard  

Keycap Puller 

User Manual  


---


**Pros:**  

Durable metal construction  

Clicky blue switches (tactile feedback)  

Tenkeyless design (more desk space)  

Affordable price  

N-Key Rollover (no ghosting)  

RGB backlighting  

50 million keystroke lifespan  

---


**Ideal For:**  

Budget gamers  

Typists who like clicky feedback  

Small desk setups (TKL layout)  

Beginners to mechanical keyboards  

Office typing
